verdict.rationale: Gusto is an HR, payroll and compliance platform, and such platforms can plausibly offer document e-signature flows, so this axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions signing order, automatic reminders, or expirations on signature requests. The cited material covers only business formation, banking, compliance filings, registered agent service and deadline alerts. Gusto's compliance deadline alerts are an adjacent feature and earn no credit for signature-request reminders.
